snippet.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis 30th Anniversary Teaser Video | Tomb Raider
snippet.description:
We revealed a new Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis sneak peek at TR30 Derby and MCM London. If you think "you've seen enough," this video contains teases of iconic content!
